scheme_name: Rajbhasha Gaurav Puraskar Scheme for writing original book in Hindi
other_conditions: The author or co‑author must be a citizen of India.
The book must be written originally in Hindi; translated books are not eligible.
The subject of the book must belong to the specified genres such as engineering, science, forensic science, police administration, culture, religion, arts, heritage, or law.
Books previously awarded by any government organization are ineligible.
The author must inform the Department of Official Language if the book receives any other award before the scheme’s award declaration.
Only books published between 1 January and 31 December are eligible.
The book must be an analytical review; theses, poems, novels, stories, plays, and textbooks are excluded.
At least 100 pages are required and the book must have a valid ISBN.
If the author has received a prize under any Department of Official Language scheme in the preceding three years, the entry is disqualified (co‑authors may still participate).
Each co‑author must submit a separate proforma if there are multiple authors.
An author may submit only one entry, accompanied by three copies of the book.
benefits_summary: Cash awards up to ₹2,00,000 along with a certificate and memento are given for original Hindi books in the specified subject areas.
